name: legal-triage
description: Configure and conduct governed, staff-facing legal enquiry triage for Australian community legal centres.

interface.shortDescription: Governed staff-facing triage for community legal centres.
interface.longDescription: Creates a centre-approved triage profile and uses it to prepare provisional, staff-reviewed enquiry records. The plugin minimises client data, keeps conflict checking outside the model, escalates urgency and uncertainty, and never makes autonomous eligibility, merits or service decisions.
defaultPrompt: Configure a governed triage profile for this community legal centre.
Prepare a provisional staff-reviewed triage record for this enquiry.
Check whether this triage profile is approved and safe to use.
